sections.heading: Why visit Auli
paragraphs: Auli (Uttarakhand) is known for its snow, mountain and adventure experiences. Overall it is mid-range — comfortable stays and good food without overspending.

paragraphs: The best time to visit is December to March for snow, April to June for meadows.

sections.heading: Insider tip
